title: Bias Association Discovery Framework for Open-Ended LLM Generations

bias_targets.methodology: Generating open-ended stories featuring male and female characters across various locations, extracting descriptive concepts using an LLM pipeline, and identifying statistically significant associations using frequency-based distinctiveness scores and chi-squared tests.

Generating open-ended stories featuring characters of different racial identities (Asian, Black, Middle-East, White) in diverse locations, extracting descriptive concepts, and identifying significant concept associations using distinctiveness scores and chi-squared tests.

Generating open-ended stories featuring characters with different religious identities (Buddhism, Christian, Judaism, Muslim) in varied locations, extracting descriptive concepts, and evaluating significant concept associations using distinctiveness scores and chi-squared tests.
